title: Glass Shelf With Towel Bar 16-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass | Satin Chrome | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Clear counter clutter and add everyday storage with this wall-mounted glass shelf—also a bathroom shelf or wall shelf—with an integrated towel bar (towel rack/towel holder) for towels at the sink in Satin Chrome, which provides a brushed, matte-like surface that resists fingerprints while maintaining a modern, understated elegance. Designed for the Waverly Place collection, it coordinates easily with matching Waverly Place pieces and complements transitional bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Satin Chrome coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Coordinates with other Waverly Place accessories for a cohesive contemporary look
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Save space with a wall mount / wall-mounted installation

Specs & Installation:
- Shelf dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
- Glass thickness: 3/8 inch (0.38 in)
- Projection from wall: 5 inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4)
- Assembly required: no
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
